title: cgroup v2：祖先限制與鄰居用量的容量帳本
titleEn: cgroup v2: ancestor limits and sibling memory accounting
subcategoryTitle: 記憶體政策、配置粒度與 RAS 證據
subcategoryTitleEn: Memory policy, allocation granularity and RAS evidence
summary: 建立父子樹與 usage、max、high 欄位；容量計算只用明示 max，high 另列為壓力控制而非硬容量替代。
summaryEn: Build the parent-child tree with usage, max and high fields. Use declared max values for this capacity calculation, while reporting high separately as a pressure-control setting rather than substituting it for a hard limit.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

quiz.question: 「cgroup v2：建立可追溯輸入與所有權」：哪一項是需要由具名官方來源查證的案例背景，而非本課的故障假說或處置判斷？
quiz.questionEn: cgroup v2: construct traceable inputs and ownership: Which is case context to establish from the named official source, rather than a fault hypothesis or disposition?
options: 工作停頓可能是 memory.high 壓力，也可能是達到 max 後的配置失敗；單一使用量快照無法區別；在教學事件表分開 high、max、oom 計數與時間戳，追蹤祖先事件；不得把所有延遲稱作 OOM。
名義可容納 6 GiB，變更不可；實際容量規劃仍須包含快取可回收性、峰值與取樣時間一致性。
容器自己的 memory.max 足夠仍可能受父群組限制；本課以靜態帳本辨識有效餘額，並分開節流、回收與 OOM 行為。
optionsEn: A stalled job may be experiencing memory.high pressure or allocation failure near max. A single usage snapshot cannot distinguish these behaviors, especially when reclaimable pages and concurrent charges exist. Keep high, max and oom events separately timestamped in the fixture and inspect ancestors as well as the leaf. Do not label every latency increase as an out-of-memory kill.

The nominal snapshot accommodates 6 GiB and the changed one does not. A real capacity plan must additionally address reclaimability, peak demand and whether parent and sibling observations were sampled consistently.

A container can fit its own memory.max and still face an ancestor limit. Build a static capacity ledger while keeping throttling, reclamation and out-of-memory behavior separate from the arithmetic model.
quiz.explanation: 本步要識別「案例與來源邊界」。容器自己的 memory.max 足夠仍可能受父群組限制；本課以靜態帳本辨識有效餘額，並分開節流、回收與 OOM 行為。 與本階段判準一起判讀：用父帳本 5+7=12 與 8+4=12 核對；改子上限為 3 的邊界案例應受子限制而非父限制；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies case and source boundary. A container can fit its own memory.max and still face an ancestor limit. Build a static capacity ledger while keeping throttling, reclamation and out-of-memory behavior separate from the arithmetic model. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Reconcile parent ledgers of 5+7=12 and 8+4=12. In a boundary case with child limit 3, verify that the child’s own ceiling becomes limiting instead of blindly returning parent headroom. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.

對照「cgroup v2：建立可追溯輸入與所有權」的名義結果，分別建立系統故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。名義可容納 6 GiB，變更不可；實際容量規劃仍須包含快取可回收性、峰值與取樣時間一致性。
本階段必須重驗：用父帳本 5+7=12 與 8+4=12 核對；改子上限為 3 的邊界案例應受子限制而非父限制；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
steps.instructionEn:
A stalled job may be experiencing memory.high pressure or allocation failure near max. A single usage snapshot cannot distinguish these behaviors, especially when reclaimable pages and concurrent charges exist. Keep high, max and oom events separately timestamped in the fixture and inspect ancestors as well as the leaf. Do not label every latency increase as an out-of-memory kill.
Against the nominal cgroup v2: construct traceable inputs and ownership result, build competing system-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. The nominal snapshot accommodates 6 GiB and the changed one does not. A real capacity plan must additionally address reclaimability, peak demand and whether parent and sibling observations were sampled consistently.
Reverify this criterion: Reconcile parent ledgers of 5+7=12 and 8+4=12. In a boundary case with child limit 3, verify that the child’s own ceiling becomes limiting instead of blindly returning parent headroom. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。工作停頓可能是 memory.high 壓力，也可能是達到 max 後的配置失敗；單一使用量快照無法區別；在教學事件表分開 high、max、oom 計數與時間戳，追蹤祖先事件；不得把所有延遲稱作 OOM。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. A stalled job may be experiencing memory.high pressure or allocation failure near max. A single usage snapshot cannot distinguish these behaviors, especially when reclaimable pages and concurrent charges exist. Keep high, max and oom events separately timestamped in the fixture and inspect ancestors as well as the leaf. Do not label every latency increase as an out-of-memory kill.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 用父帳本 5+7=12 與 8+4=12 核對；改子上限為 3 的邊界案例應受子限制而非父限制；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
steps.checkEn: Reconcile parent ledgers of 5+7=12 and 8+4=12. In a boundary case with child limit 3, verify that the child’s own ceiling becomes limiting instead of blindly returning parent headroom. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: 容器自己的 memory.max 足夠仍可能受父群組限制；本課以靜態帳本辨識有效餘額，並分開節流、回收與 OOM 行為。
knowledge.textEn: A container can fit its own memory.max and still face an ancestor limit. Build a static capacity ledger while keeping throttling, reclamation and out-of-memory behavior separate from the arithmetic model.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 建立父子樹與 usage、max、high 欄位；容量計算只用明示 max，high 另列為壓力控制而非硬容量替代。
knowledge.textEn: Build the parent-child tree with usage, max and high fields. Use declared max values for this capacity calculation, while reporting high separately as a pressure-control setting rather than substituting it for a hard limit.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 在不可回收且無其他支出的簡化前提下，子群可用預算為 min(子上限,父上限－兄弟用量)；這不是核心下一次配置結果的預測。
knowledge.textEn: Assuming no reclaimable memory or other charges, available child budget is the smaller of its own limit and parent headroom after sibling usage. This does not predict a kernel allocation’s exact outcome.

steps.objective: 完成「cgroup v2：建立可追溯輸入與所有權」的驗收並留下交接件，以本階段判據形成可複查成果。
steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for cgroup v2: construct traceable inputs and ownership and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付限制樹、容量帳本、限制來源與事件分類表，並附時間不同步的拒絕案例。
在交接件中加入「cgroup v2：建立可追溯輸入與所有權」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：用父帳本 5+7=12 與 8+4=12 核對；改子上限為 3 的邊界案例應受子限制而非父限制；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：建立父子樹與 usage、max、high 欄位；容量計算只用明示 max，high 另列為壓力控制而非硬容量替代。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver the hierarchy, budget ledger, limiting-ancestor explanation and classified event table. Include a rejection case for incompatible snapshot times so apparently precise arithmetic cannot conceal inconsistent observations.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for cgroup v2: construct traceable inputs and ownership: Reconcile parent ledgers of 5+7=12 and 8+4=12. In a boundary case with child limit 3, verify that the child’s own ceiling becomes limiting instead of blindly returning parent headroom. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Build the parent-child tree with usage, max and high fields. Use declared max values for this capacity calculation, while reporting high separately as a pressure-control setting rather than substituting it for a hard limit. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.

Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.

steps.failureEn: Declaring success when the alert clears without re-verifying the investigation criterion.
